_comment: TEMPLATE - copy to config/my_dataset.json and replace every <...> value. Delete keys you do not have. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
name: my_farm_dataset
_column_map_help: internal name -> YOUR column header. Required: timestamp, soil_moisture. Strongly recommended: temperature_c, humidity_pct, rainfall_mm. Optional: field_id, crop_type, soil_type, irrigation_method, planting_date, latitude, target_irrigation_needed, target_irrigation_mm.
_timestamp_help: timestamp_format uses Python strftime codes, null = auto-detect. timestamp_offset_hours is ADDED to convert to field-local time (UTC data in India -> 5.5).
_units_help: soil_moisture: percent | fraction | raw (raw needs soil_raw_calibration). temperature: celsius | fahrenheit | kelvin. rainfall: mm | inch. rainfall_mode: interval (rain since previous row) | cumulative (running total).
_fields_help: Metadata per field. crop_type: groundnut|maize|onion|potato|tomato|wheat|cotton. soil_type: sandy|sandy_loam|loam|clay_loam|clay. irrigation_method: drip|sprinkler|furrow. Values in per_field override defaults; columns in the file override both only if mapped.
_labels_help: derive = compute FAO-56 weak labels from your observations. columns = use your own labels: add target_irrigation_needed (0/1) and optionally target_irrigation_mm to column_map.

extra._note: free-form settings for your own code in irrigation_advisor/data/dataset_hooks.py
